title: Step 7c - Visualizing Logistic Regression Performance on New Data in Python

cues.en: -: All right, so now you understand it better.
cues.zh: 現在應該更理解了。

cues.en: But remember that these are the training set results.
cues.zh: 但記住，這些是訓練集結果。

cues.en: Therefore all these customers that we see here are actually in the training set.
cues.zh: 圖中所有顧客都來自訓練集。

cues.en: Therefore, these are customers with which are logistic regression model was trained.
cues.zh: 模型就是用這些顧客訓練。

cues.en: And therefore that's kind of easy to provide such results because these are exactly the observations of the training.
cues.zh: 因此得到這種結果相對容易，因為都是學過的觀測。

cues.en: But now what we would like to see is how our logistic regression model was able to perform on new observations, meaning on the observations
cues.zh: 現在要看模型對新觀測的表現，也就是

cues.en: of the test set, the customers of the test set because indeed the customers of the test set are new customers with which our logistic regression model wasn't trained.
cues.zh: 測試集顧客；這些是新顧客，模型訓練沒用過。

cues.en: And so we have to see if our logistic regression model was still able to separate well the two classes meaning the customers who bought the SUV
cues.zh: 要看即使是沒訓練過的新顧客，模型是否仍能區分

cues.en: and the customers who didn't buy the SUV even despite the fact that these are new customers on which the model wasn't trained.
cues.zh: 買了 SUV 與沒買的兩類。

cues.en: And that's exactly what we're about to see now when visualizing the test set results we already executed the cell here.
cues.zh: 現在視覺化測試集，儲存格已執行。

cues.en: And so these are the test set results.
cues.zh: 這就是測試結果。

cues.en: And still our logistic progression model was perfectly able to separate well the two classes, zero, all those red points here, and one all those green points.
cues.zh: 模型仍能很好區分兩類：0 是紅點，1 是綠點。

cues.en: There are still some incorrect predictions, of course like this customer who in reality didn't buy the new the brand new beautiful SUV, but was predicted to buy it.
cues.zh: 當然仍有錯誤，例如這位實際沒買新 SUV，卻被預測會買。

cues.en: And a few incorrect predictions here of the other class meaning these customers who in reality bought the SUV but were predicted not to because they fall in the red region, all right?
cues.zh: 另一類也有幾個錯誤：實際買了，卻落在紅區，被預測沒買。

cues.en: And so how can we conclude here?
cues.zh: 可以得出什麼結論？

cues.en: What should we conclude and what are the takeaways we should get for our future classification models?
cues.zh: 對未來分類模型，有什麼重點？

cues.en: Well, first the logistic regression model does a very good job at separating our two classes and therefore at predicting whether the customers bought SUV,
cues.zh: 首先，邏輯斯迴歸能很好區分兩類，預測顧客有沒有買 SUV，

cues.en: but we actually would hope to build a model that has less prediction errors.
cues.zh: 但我們仍希望模型錯誤更少。

cues.en: And how can we build one?
cues.zh: 如何建立？

cues.en: What would we need to get as the prediction curve, in order not to predict incorrectly all these wrong predictions here, all these customers here.
cues.zh: 預測曲線要長什麼樣，才不會將這些顧客判錯？

cues.en: Well, we actually would need a prediction boundary that is something else than a straight line.
cues.zh: 需要一個不是直線的預測邊界。

cues.en: Because even if you try to rotate your prediction line for example, to be like that well, it will still catch many incorrect predictions.
cues.zh: 就算旋轉直線到這個方向，仍會有很多錯誤。

cues.en: So what we would need to get, optimally, is some kind of curve, some kind of prediction curve that goes this way, catches all the red points,
cues.zh: 理想情況，曲線應往這邊走，將這些紅點、

cues.en: all the red customers here, and then go around like this in order to catch all the red points, the red customers and leave all the green points the green customers inside the green region.
cues.zh: 紅色顧客包住，再繞過這裡，讓所有紅點留在紅區，綠點留在綠區。

cues.en: And well, as you might guess, this is what we might be able to get with non-linear classifiers.
cues.zh: 你可能猜到了，非線性分類器可能做得到。

cues.en: I won't tell you more now, but be ready for some even more performance classification models that manage to separate even better, these two classes.
cues.zh: 先不多說，準備學效能更好、更能區分兩類的分類模型。

cues.en: So there we go, that was the big part of the job.
cues.zh: 這是主要的基礎工作。

cues.en: You did it and now follow me in the next sections to implement the other classification models.
cues.zh: 你完成了，接著一起在後面章節實作其他分類模型。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
